GPU Pricing

# GPU Cloud Pricing

Runpod pricing depends on the GPU workload you run: Pods for dedicated GPU instances, Serverless for API inference, and Clusters for multi-node jobs. For enterprise capacity, review compliance resources or request enterprise support.

![Purple glow background](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69ce570adca53340abab8376/69e1d120e44fc5fb8bdabf77_glow-medium.avif)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69ce570adca53340abab8376/69e1cfae5ccab7246789bad6_background-stars-hollow.svg)

## How Runpod pricing works

Runpod pricing is based on the type of GPU workload you run. [Pods](/product/cloud-gpus) are dedicated GPU instances for development and long-running jobs, [Serverless](/product/serverless) bills inference workers based on usage, and [Clusters](/product/clusters) support multi-node workloads and reserved capacity.

Storage and deployment choices affect total cost, so teams should choose the model that matches workload duration, traffic pattern, and control needs. Updated July 27, 2026.
